headline: Weathered and Mooring Fronts Register New Shifts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger shows the heaviest movement still concentrated in Weathered Expanse and Mooring County. Weathered now stands at one Warden, five Colonial, and three neutral strategic bases, with 81 base events in 24 hours and six in the latest two-hour window. Mooring County has likewise shifted to eight Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base; its 63 daily events include two in the latest window. Both fronts remain costly, though their recent casualty rates are generally cooling. Stlican Shelf has emerged as another active sector, reporting nine daily base events, three of them in the latest two hours, with one Warden and eight Colonial positions. Marban Hollow remains divided at one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base, but its 13-event ledger has gone quiet since the previous edition. Callahan’s Passage retains all ten Warden bases after 16 daily events and no recent movement. Nevish Line records nine events, with seven Warden and one Colonial base, but no action in the latest two-hour period. The broader front is otherwise largely still.
